task_title: Correct CF-171 AC3: gate on a string absent at the tree, not a green-by-default arm
task_criteria: At commit eada934 on origin/main, CF-171's acceptance criterion 3 gates on a string that is absent at that tree: grep -c -i 'allowlist' specs/HARNESS.md returns 0 (the previously cited 'inference' hit at specs/HARNESS.md:36 is an unrelated error string, so the old arm was green before any work). The row still carries three criteria, tasks.jsonl still has 145 lines with byte-identical prefix lines, event 267 records the measurement, bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS (rc 0) and bash scripts/boardctl validate prints RESULT: OK. The CF-002 repair itself remains future work tracked by CF-171 and is NOT expected at this commit.
